brand.name: Escobar Coffee
brand.business_model: B2B coffee supplier — HoReCa, offices, corporate clients
brand.founded_stage: Scaling — transition from fixed office to distributed partner model
logo_assets: img/Asset 3.svg (dark teal version — for light backgrounds)

primary.language: Practical, specific, numbers-first. They don't care about origin stories — they care about margin, consistency, and service.

pain_points: Coffee machine breakdowns with no support

coffee_varieties.description_template: Назва: [name]. Країна: [origin]. Обробка: [process — washed/natural/honey]. Смаковий профіль: [flavor notes from scale]. Рекомендований спосіб: [espresso/filter/both]. B2B-angle: [why this variety works for cafe/office/horeca context].
coffee_varieties.tone_for_descriptions: Professional, concise, no purple prose. Flavor notes are factual. B2B angle is practical.

equipment.type: Rental + sale of espresso machines and grinders
equipment.catalog_format: Online catalog with AR elements (in development)
equipment.showroom: Minimal showroom in central Kyiv — for final decision only

known_rules: No exclamation marks in B2B communication
Numbers over adjectives: '3-day delivery' not 'fast delivery'
Partner language: speak to them as business equals
tov.voice_direction: A systematic, experienced B2B supplier who doesn't need to shout. Confident. Specific. Respects the client's time.

linkedin.objective: B2B lead generation + thought leadership in HoReCa
content_pillars: Product/education: coffee variety spotlights, brew guides for baristas (25%)
Behind the scenes: roasting process, sourcing, quality control (20%)
Partner stories: case studies from partner cafes (15%)
linkedin.CTA_style: Soft B2B — 'Зв'яжіться з нами' or 'Замовте тестову партію'

instagram.objective: Brand awareness + partner UGC showcase + product visibility
content_pillars: Educational: brew guides, tips for baristas (20%)
instagram.visual_style: Warm but structured. Orange accent. Real environments — not studio white. Slight film grain.

style_constraints.language: Ukrainian (primary), English (secondary for LinkedIn international reach)
style_constraints.copy_style: B2B professional — not corporate robot, not lifestyle blog
style_constraints.visual_direction: Warm, amber tones. Real roastery / real cafe environments. Orange brand color as accent only — not overwhelming.
style_constraints.safe_zone_for_text: bottom 30% for Instagram, full overlay allowed for LinkedIn carousels

client_taste_profile.human_presence: occasional — baristas, partners. Not stock-model people.
client_taste_profile.texture_preference: real materials — burlap, wood, ceramic, steam
client_taste_profile.aesthetic_reference: premium craft B2B — think Lavazza B2B comms, not Blue Bottle consumer
client_taste_profile.what_to_avoid: White marble flat lay. Cold blue tones. Overly perfect symmetry. Consumer lifestyle clichés.

pipeline.phase_3_future: CRM setup + chatbot scripts + lead gen sequences
